mentions.name: Filesystem-based macOS photos viewer
mentions.description: A macOS photo viewer that works directly on the filesystem instead of storing photos in a monolithic opaque library.
mentions.problem: Existing photo apps rely on a monolithic opaque library instead of the filesystem.
mentions.source_excerpt: macOS photos viewer based on the filesystem instead of a monolithic opaque "library"

evidence.value: macOS photos viewer based on the filesystem instead of a monolithic opaque "library"
